name: Farcha (Portuguese Style Fried Chicken)
instructions: 1. Marinate chicken with spices. 2. Dip in beaten egg and coat with breadcrumbs. 3. Deep fry until golden and crispy.
description: Crispy, spice-crusted chicken, a legacy of Daman's Portuguese maritime history.
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
